전시회명: JFEX JAPAN INT’L FOOD & BEVERAGE EXPO
축제소개: The "JFEX Summer JAPAN INT'L FOOD & BEVERAGE EXPO", an international fair in Tokyo, is dedicated to showcasing food and beverages from around the world. "JFEX", short for "Japan Food Expo", reflects the event's focus on the food industry. This trade fair takes place twice a year at Tokyo Big Sight, one of Japan's leading exhibition centers. It is organized by RX Japan Ltd., a company known for its extensive experience and expertise in organizing international exhibitions. JFEX is divided into four main areas: JFEX FOOD, focusing on frozen foods, ready-to-eat meals, agricultural and seafood products, confectionery, and spices; JFEX WINE and SPIRITS, presenting alcoholic beverages such as wine, beer, whisky, liqueurs, sake, and shochu; JFEX MEAT and DAIRY, specializing in meat and dairy products; and JFEX PREMIUM, showcasing luxury food items, confectionery, agricultural products, and both alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages. The fair offers an excellent platform for exploring the diversity and innovations of the global food and beverage industry, particularly from Japan. It provides insights into current trends and serves as a meeting point for business contacts and networking. Exhibitors range from food and beverage manufacturers to agricultural companies and providers of packaging and processing technologies. The main visitors include professionals from the food industry, retailers and wholesalers, importers, exporters, and restaurateurs. JFEX is not only a central meeting point for professionals but also reflects the local culture and gastronomy. Tokyo, the venue, is known for its culinary diversity and its role as a trade and industrial center. As part of a global series of fairs representing the food and beverage industry, JFEX plays a significant role in the sector. Tokyo Big Sight in Tokyo stands out for its strategically advantageous location and excellent accessibility. It is an ideal place for international exhibitions and boasts an excellent infrastructure that is easily accessible by both public transport and car, facilitating participation for international visitors and exhibitors.

The " Made in Pakistan " is an annual trade show that showcases Pakistan's industrial capacities and economic potential. It is organized by the Trade Development Authority of Pakistan in collaboration with the Ministry of Commerce of Saudi Arabia. The event is held at the Jeddah International Exhibition & Convention Center in Jeddah, a global hub ideally suited for business meetings and with excellent flight connections. The fair focuses on four main sectors: engineering, textiles and apparel, agricultural products, and services. It features products and services from areas such as sports equipment, pharmaceuticals, towels, ready-made clothing, processed foods, and architectural design. This diversity highlights the wide range of high-quality goods and services that Pakistan offers internationally. The Made in Pakistan serves not only as a B2B platform but also as a forum for dialogue and cooperation among entrepreneurs, investors, and government representatives. It provides a unique opportunity for direct networking and initiating collaborations. Participants from various industries, including manufacturing, healthcare, and the textile industry, emphasize the significance and scope of the fair. A highlight of the event is the sector-specific panel discussions and live demonstrations of new technologies, making the fair a dynamic venue for exchange and promoting excellence. Finally, it is worth noting that the Jeddah International Exhibition & Convention Center impresses not only with its modern facilities and excellent accessibility but also with its location in Jeddah—a commercial and cultural center of Saudi Arabia and a gateway to the Islamic world. This underscores the strategic importance of the fair in promoting international trade and economic cooperation. The "Made in Pakistan" is thus a key meeting point for all those interested in expanding global markets and deepening bilateral trade relationships.

" The Aqua Culture Expo " ( TAEX ) is a leading trade fair held annually at the India Expo Centre & Mart in Greater Noida, a dynamic economic region in the heart of India. Organized by PIXIE Expo Media, TAEX attracts an international audience of industry experts and decision-makers from the aquaculture sector. The venue, close to the capital city of Delhi, is known for its excellent accessibility and modern infrastructure, providing an ideal platform for exhibitors and visitors from around the world. TAEX stands for innovation and progress in aquaculture. The fair showcases the latest solutions, technologies, research findings, and products and services aimed at increasing efficiency and sustainability. Key topics include feed equipment, fish and shrimp production, processing techniques, health products, and sustainable practices. A highlight of the fair is the conferences and seminars led by leading sector experts, as well as the "Awards for Excellence in Aqua Sector", which honor outstanding contributions to the industry. These awards emphasize the importance of innovation and high-quality standards in the sector. The fair offers a variety of products, including state-of-the-art bottling equipment, automated systems for process control, advanced logistics solutions, and sustainable packaging materials. The presentation of these products reflects the dynamism and technological development of the aquaculture industry and its connection to India's rapidly growing economy. Exhibitors, including technology providers, feed suppliers, and equipment manufacturers, meet with professionals from aquaculture, investors, and industry analysts. TAEX serves as a central meeting point to network, foster business, and discuss the latest industry trends. Finally, the India Expo Centre & Mart, with its excellent location and transportation connections, provides the ideal venue for such an international event. Its proximity to Delhi also allows visitors to explore the cultural and historical attractions of the region. Thus, TAEX is not only a marketplace for innovations and business development but also a window into the diverse culture and economy of India.

개최장소(베뉴): WTCMM World Trade Center Metro Manila
축제소개: The "Philippine Food Expo" (PFE) is a leading trade fair for the Philippine food and beverage industry. It serves as a central platform for producers, traders, and investors to showcase and discuss innovations, trends, and market opportunities in the agricultural and food sectors. Organized by PHILFOODEX INC., the expo takes place annually at the World Trade Center Metro Manila, bringing together key industry players. A particular focus is placed on evolving consumer habits, influenced by rising incomes, urbanization, and population growth. The expo highlights the challenges and opportunities of globalization in the food trade while emphasizing sustainable solutions. Companies present strategies to enhance productivity, optimize resource utilization, and ensure a stable market demand. The extensive range of products includes a variety of beverages such as juices, coffee, tea, milk, wine, and spirits, as well as baked goods, dairy products, chilled and frozen foods, confectionery, and fresh and processed fruits and vegetables. Additionally, seafood, herbs, organic health foods, and modern food equipment and accessories are featured. The expo portfolio is further enriched by packaging and labeling solutions, franchising, industry publications, packaging design, and distribution management. As a result, the Philippine Food Expo serves as a comprehensive platform for manufacturers, distributors, restaurateurs, and retailers. One of the standout features of the expo is its interactive special events, distinguishing it from other industry fairs. These include culinary competitions for students and faculty in hospitality management and culinary arts, featuring disciplines such as food styling and photography, healthy pasta, and Philippine regional table setting. The program is complemented by professional and business seminars offering valuable insights into current market strategies and industry developments. An investment forum provides new business perspectives, while targeted media exposure ensures broad public awareness. The Philippine Food Expo is not only a showcase for Philippine products but also highlights Manila's role as a hub for the food industry in Southeast Asia. It brings together professionals from production, distribution, gastronomy, retail, and technology, all seeking new business opportunities, partnerships, and innovative solutions. As a national flagship event, it sets industry benchmarks and contributes to the advancement of the country’s agricultural and food sectors. The venue, the World Trade Center Metro Manila, is situated in an economically vibrant region with excellent infrastructure. The expo is easily accessible from the Ninoy Aquino International Airport and Manila’s major business districts. This makes the Philippine Food Expo not only a must-attend event for industry professionals but also a gateway to one of Asia’s fastest-growing food markets.

개최장소(베뉴): Diamond Island Convention and Exhibition Center
축제소개: Aqua Fisheries Cambodia is Cambodia’s leading trade fair for aquaculture, fisheries, and seafood processing. More than just a marketplace, it serves as a central meeting point for professionals, innovators, and decision-makers in a sector that plays a vital role in the country’s food security and economic development. Organized by VEAS Co., Ltd., a seasoned exhibition organizer with strong regional expertise, Aqua Fisheries Cambodia opens its doors every autumn at the Diamond Island Convention and Exhibition Center (DIECC) in Phnom Penh. Conveniently located on the banks of the Mekong River, the modern venue symbolizes the significance of water, fisheries, and the sustainable use of natural resources. Aqua Fisheries Cambodia focuses on the entire value chain of aquaculture and fisheries – from innovative technologies in fish and shrimp farming to modern fishing methods, equipment, processing systems, and packaging solutions. Exhibitors also include providers in animal health and nutrition, whose products play a crucial role in improving breeding quality and efficiency. Sustainability is a key theme, showcased through practical solutions, resource-efficient technologies, and internationally recognized best practices. Exhibitors span a wide range of industries, including mechanical engineering, veterinary science, feed production, logistics, and environmental technology. Visitors primarily come from Cambodia, Southeast Asia, and surrounding regions. Trade professionals from the fishing and aquaculture industries, wholesale and retail sectors, research institutions, and government bodies attend the event to exchange knowledge and build networks. Aqua Fisheries Cambodia offers significant added value through its expert forums, conferences, and live demonstrations. Targeted B2B matchmaking sessions encourage direct interaction and generate tangible business opportunities—for both exhibitors and visitors. With its central location, the Phnom Penh venue provides excellent infrastructure for international guests. The DIECC is easily accessible from the airport by taxi or shuttle bus. As a dynamic capital city with growing importance in the agricultural and export sectors, Phnom Penh is ideally positioned near the resource-rich waters of the Tonle Sap and the Mekong—making it the perfect setting for an event that captures the pulse of an entire industry.

The Taiwan Smart Agriweek is an international trade fair that represents a milestone in the fields of smart agriculture, fisheries, livestock breeding, and cold chain. The "Taiwan Smart Agriweek" and reflects Taiwan's central role in the development and demonstration of modern agricultural technologies. This annual event takes place at the Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center in Taipei, a central hub for trade and innovation in Taiwan, and stands out for its uniqueness. Organized by MY Exhibition Co. Ltd., Taiwan Smart Agriweek serves as an innovative center that facilitates the exchange and promotion of the latest technologies and methods in agriculture and related industries. It covers five main areas: AgriTech, AgriLivestock, AgriFresh, AgriGreen, and the International Aquaculture & Fisheries Expo. These sections provide comprehensive insights into smart agricultural technologies, advanced approaches in livestock and poultry breeding, contemporary cold chain solutions for fresh produce, sustainable fisheries and aquaculture practices, as well as high-quality seafood. Taiwan Smart Agriweek showcases a wide variety of products and services, including state-of-the-art agricultural machinery, groundbreaking biotechnologies, and automation systems, all aimed at enhancing the quality and yield in agriculture and fisheries. The fair reflects Taiwan's commitment to industrial innovation and sustainable development, establishing a strong connection with the city and the country. Another highlight of the fair is the more than 10 international expert forums where leading-edge topics are discussed. These are complemented by group tours, business matchmaking, and negotiation meetings held on-site. These elements significantly contribute to dialogue and collaboration among various industries and global experts. Exhibitors from sectors such as agricultural technology, livestock breeding, aquaculture, and food cold chain meet with a specialized audience consisting of experts from these and related fields who are interested in the latest developments and trends. As a standalone event, Taiwan Smart Agriweek distinguishes itself with its specific focus on smart agricultural technologies in Taiwan. In summary, the Taiwan Smart Agriweek is a central event for professionals in agriculture and related sectors. The easily accessible Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center in Taipei provides the perfect backdrop for this significant international exchange of knowledge and technology.

Riga Food is a leading trade fair for the food industry, held annually at the International Exhibition Centre Kipsala in Riga, Latvia. It serves as a central meeting point for industry experts from all over Europe and the world, providing a platform to showcase new products and exchange information about the latest developments in food and beverage production, processing, packaging, as well as catering, gastronomy, and hospitality. The fair is organized by the Exhibition Company BT 1, known for providing professional conditions that enable business professionals to expand their networks and present innovative solutions and services. The fair covers a wide range of topics, including advanced technologies in production and packaging, as well as services for hotels and public catering establishments. A distinctive feature of "Riga Food" is its close connection to Riga and the Baltic region. Through competitions like the Baltic Taste Award, high-quality regional foods are honored and made known internationally. Additionally, the fair offers a stage for spectacular events such as cooking and bartender competitions, attracting both professional visitors and interested guests. Exhibitors come from various sectors of the food industry, including manufacturing, processing, and services. The main target audience of the fair are professionals interested in the latest industry trends and looking to expand their business activities. The venue, the International Exhibition Centre Kipsala, is easily accessible and offers modern facilities, making it an ideal location for this large-scale event. In conclusion, "Riga Food" is not just a trade fair, but also a cultural event that showcases the culinary diversity and innovation of the food industry in a dynamic and interactive environment.

Fishex , a leading international expo for the fisheries and seafood industry, is held annually at the renowned Canton Fair Complex (China Import & Export Fair Canton Fair Complex) in Guangzhou. It is organized by Guangzhou Boyi Global Exhibition Co., Ltd., and provides a comprehensive platform where exhibitors and professional visitors from around the world can explore and discuss the latest products, services, and technological solutions in fisheries and aquaculture. The name "Fishex" stands for "Fishery Exhibition" and highlights the expo's focus on showcasing and promoting the fishing industry and its related markets. The offerings include a wide range of exhibition areas, featuring fresh and processed seafood, aquaculture equipment, feed, and processing technologies. Special attention is given to specialized areas for geographically protected fish products, cold chain solutions, and ready meals for commercial kitchens. The expo benefits from its location in Guangzhou, a central hub of maritime trade in China, making it a key meeting point for both local and international industry stakeholders. The exhibition area for renowned and unique fish products from the Guangdong region emphasizes local brands and products, strengthening connections to the city and province. Annual highlights of Fishex include forums, conferences, and seminars led by industry experts. These events offer valuable insights and foster exchanges on innovations and best practices. Visitors can learn about the latest trends, participate in tastings, and receive personalized gifts. The expo attracts a broad spectrum of industry participants, including companies from aquaculture and seafood sectors, providers of processing equipment, and experts in water management and cooling solutions. The main audience consists of buyers and suppliers, underscoring Fishex's significance for the global food and beverage industry. The Canton Fair Complex was chosen as the venue due to its excellent infrastructure and accessibility by both public and private transport. This location facilitates access for international visitors and promotes global trade and exchange in the fisheries industry. Fishex serves not only as an expo but also as a crucial hub for innovation, trade, and cooperation in the global fisheries economy.

Founded in 1960, Nor-Fishing in Trondheim is a significant international trade fair for the fishing industry. The name symbolizes the connection to Nordic fishing, which is deeply rooted both historically and economically in Norwegian culture. This biennial event takes place at the Trondheim Spektrum and is organized by the Nor-Fishing Foundation, attracting industry professionals and enthusiasts from around the world every two years. The Trondheim Spektrum, a modern convention and exhibition center, provides the ideal setting for the fair. The exhibition features a wide range of products and services, from cutting-edge fishing equipment and navigation devices to safety gear and fishing vessels. The fair focuses on sustainability and innovative technologies that promote environmentally friendly fishing methods and green technologies. Experts share their knowledge on current trends and developments in the industry through numerous conferences and seminars. This makes the fair an indispensable venue for knowledge exchange and networking. A special highlight is the presentation of the Nor-Fishing Innovation Award, which honors outstanding contributions to the fishing industry. The fair serves not only as a platform for exchanging expertise and showcasing innovations but also for forging and strengthening business relationships. It attracts exhibitors from various sectors of the fishing industry, making it a central event for professionals from this and related sectors. The close connection between Nor-Fishing, the city of Trondheim, and Norway highlights the country's leading role in the fishing industry. The fair significantly contributes to strengthening Norway's position as a leader of innovation in this sector. Nor-Fishing offers an essential platform for anyone involved in the fishing industry or interested in sustainable and advanced methods. It provides a unique opportunity to learn about the latest technologies and to make important contacts for future innovations.
